mapper.insert: insert into seckill_manual_compensation_log( operator, operation_type, message_ids, request_limit, manual_stream_key, result_count, success, error_message, create_time ) values( #{operator}, #{operationType}, #{messageIds}, #{requestLimit}, #{manualStreamKey}, #{resultCount}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, now() )
mapper.select: select id, operator, operation_type, message_ids, request_limit, manual_stream_key, result_count, success, error_message, create_time from seckill_manual_compensation_log order by create_time desc, id desc limit #{limit}
